subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous set of generic runtime objects and lifetime/collision primitives: a state-flag zero getter, a family of three state-dependent vtable-dispatch functions driven by ShortComputation_6720 (0x00486720) that dispatch vtable slot obj+0x40 with a group-selected argument, then call an unconditional post slot (obj+0x98 or obj+0x9C) and iterate the child dispatch list via VTableDispatchListIteration (0x00490660); a memory-pool/allocator teardown driven by globals dword_7CD9D0/dword_7CD9CC; broadphase collision-culling primitives (subtractive rectangle clipping allocating clipped nodes via ResourcePoolNodeAllocDealloc 0x00490940, plus two AABB tests sharing the four-__int16 box layout at this+0/0x2/0x4/0x6); two structurally twin doubly-linked-list appends with distinct embedded headers (0x18CC-0x18D8 vs 0x18DC-0x18E8); a recursive tree walker dispatching a virtual per-node callback at vtable slot obj+0xA0; a family of conditional free/teardown helpers (self-free on flag, payload free, inner-and-self free) all routed through FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF); trivial field getters/setters; string-buffer setters via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650); global readers; and callback-registration shims through BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E). Every packet owner is UNKNOWN, so all class groupings are GUESS worker proposals.

summary: Reconstruction of generic runtime objects from 40 validated function IR records. The packet supplies UNKNOWN owners for every function except 0x00491680 (owner AxisAlignedBoundingBox, DERIVED) and a small set of DERIVED prose labels. All class groupings below are GUESS worker proposals. The strongest cross-function groupings are: (1) the ShortComputation_6720 state-dispatch family (0x00490330/0x00490390/0x004903F0) which share the state source, the obj+0x40 command slot and the VTableDispatchListIteration tail but differ in group arguments (2/5, 4/1, 1/4) and in the unconditional post slot (obj+0x98 for 0x00490330, obj+0x9C for the other two); (2) the AABB cluster (0x004915A0/0x00491680) sharing the four-__int16 box layout and broadphase callers; (3) the conditional free/teardown helper family (0x00491E60/0x00491E80/0x00499620) all routing through FreeWrapper_7bcf; (4) the two doubly-linked-list appends (0x004966E0/0x004967D0) which are structurally twin but are kept as separate classes because their embedded list headers sit at different this offsets (rule 8). The two twin this+0x44 getters (0x00498F70/0x0049904C) are merged into FieldGetter only as a proposal, with the packet's own warning that equal offsets on unrelated this pointers are not proof of shared class recorded in unresolved. Explicitly unmodeled: the jump-table mappings of the three dispatch functions, the identity of the vtable-slot callees, and the semantics of the desciptor-relative list fields in 0x00490850.

function_roles.role: State-flag zero getter (__thiscall): returns whether the word at field this+0xE0 is zero; used as a state-flag zero check before proceeding by its callers ParameterValueClampingAcrossArray (0x0047A080) and SuspensionFloatClamp (0x0047A290).

State-dependent vtable dispatch: computes state via ShortComputation_6720 (0x00486720) and switches on it through jump table jpt_49033D (0x00490370); states 0-2 dispatch the vtable slot at obj+0x40 with argument 2, states 3-5 with argument 5, the default path dispatches nothing; then unconditionally calls the vtable slot at obj+0x98, iterates the child dispatch list via VTableDispatchListIteration (0x00490660), and returns 0.

State-dependent vtable dispatch: computes state via ShortComputation_6720 (0x00486720) and switches on it through jump table jpt_49039D (0x004903D0); states 0-2 dispatch the vtable slot at obj+0x40 with argument 4, states 3-5 with argument 1, the default path dispatches nothing; then unconditionally calls the vtable slot at obj+0x9C, iterates the child dispatch list via VTableDispatchListIteration (0x00490660), and returns 0.

State-dependent vtable dispatch (thiscall): computes state via ShortComputation_6720 (0x00486720) and switches on it through jump table jpt_4903FD (0x0049042C); groups 0-2 dispatch the vtable slot at obj+0x40 with argument 1, groups 3-5 with argument 4, any other value skips the vtable dispatch; every path iterates the child dispatch list via VTableDispatchListIteration (0x00490660) and returns 0. Unlike the two siblings it has no unconditional post-dispatch vtable call.

Tears down a custom memory-pool/allocator subsystem: destroys and frees the allocator handle global dword_7CD9D0 (conditional destructor 0x00491740 then FreeWrapper_7bcf 0x00587BCF), then, when the pool descriptor global dword_7CD9CC is non-null, walks and frees two linked lists rooted in the descriptor (a used list at descriptor offset +16 and a free list at descriptor start), running per-node conditional cleanup helpers ShortComputation_1e60 (0x00491E60) and UtilityFunction_1e80 (0x00491E80), zeroing each list's head fields, and freeing the pool descriptor itself; returns the free-call result, or the descriptor value (0) when dword_7CD9CC was null.

Subtractive rectangle clipping: computes the area of a subject rectangle (this+0 x1, this+2 y1, this+4 / this+6 extents, all __int16) that lies outside a boundary rectangle (a2..a5), splits the space into a 3 by 3 grid, allocates a resource-pool node per surviving cell via ResourcePoolNodeAllocDealloc (0x00490940), copies the metadata word from this+8 into node+8, links the nodes into a singly linked list via the next-pointer at node offset 12, and returns the list head (0 when the subject is entirely inside the boundary).

AABB containment check: returns 1 when the `this` AABB (x1 this+0, y1 this+2, width this+4, height this+6 as four __int16) lies fully inside the boundary AABB (a2, a3, a4, a5 with a4/a5 as widths); returns 0 otherwise. Called by sub_490D00 (0x00490D00) and CollisionBroadphaseTraversal (0x00491170), placing it in broadphase collision culling.

AABB overlap test: the this box is stored as four __int16 (min X this+0, min Y this+2, X span this+4, Y span this+6); the query box is given as min X, min Y, width and height (a2..a5). Both axes are clamped to the shared interval; the function returns whether the clamped Y span is positive, i.e. whether the boxes overlap. Packet owner is AxisAlignedBoundingBox (DERIVED).

Single-call delegation shim: reads the object pointer stored at this+0x0, adds 60 bytes to form a _WORD* first argument, then delegates to ShortComputation_16e0 with that pointer plus the four __int16 values a2..a5, returning the __int16 result unchanged.

__thiscall teardown helper: frees its own object via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) when the low bit of the flag argument a2 is set, and always returns this afterwards. Used by ResourceLinkedListTeardown (0x00490850) and MultiListDestruction (0x00490B90) as a per-node cleanup step.

Conditional payload free: reads the pointer stored at this+0x0; when it is non-null, treats it as a pointer to the payload of an allocation whose base lies 4 bytes earlier and hands that base to FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF); when null, returns null without freeing. Used during resource linked-list teardown (caller 0x00490850).

Registration shim: passes the address of the LinkedListCleanupDestroy routine (global 0x00494630) to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) and returns the integer it produces; most plausibly a one-line callback/registration wrapper.

Identity passthrough: returns its first argument a1 unchanged. The decompiler flagged the frame as unreliable and deterministic facts record a read of global dword_7CDDFC that the rendered source does not show.
Trivial global read: returns the value of dword_8B8DC8 (0x008B8DC8) with no arguments and no side effects; its only recorded caller is UIScrollViewRender (0x00486AC0).
Trivial global read: returns the current int value of dword_7CDE20 (0x007CDE20) with no parameters, no writes and no callees; its only known caller is FileLoadWithRetryLoop (0x004F9B70).

Single-call wrapper (__stdcall): reads the dword at this+0x44 and passes it straight to TreeWalkerVirtualCallRecurse, returning that callee's result. Called by ShortComputation_58d0 (0x004958D0) to recurse into the child structure held at +0x44.

Recursively walks a linked tree of nodes: rejects a NULL root with -1, then for each node invokes a virtual per-node callback (function pointer at vtable offset +160, obj+0xA0), recurses into the child subtree at dword index 36 (this+0x90), advances along the sibling chain (node[35]), and returns 0 after a full traversal.
Field getter (__thiscall): returns the dword at this+0x18 (this[6]) unchanged; no writes, callees or guards. Its only known caller is ObjectSearchWithDoubleIteration (0x00495980).

Drains a list by repeatedly invoking sub_495AE0 (0x00495AE0) while the element at this+0x18 (this[6]) is non-null and the permission check ShortComputation_8f70 (0x00498F70) returns exactly 1; exits the loop when the check returns a value other than 1 or the list element becomes null.
Flag setter (__thiscall): unconditionally writes constant 1 to the dword at this+0x28 (this[10]) and returns 0; no guards, callees or globals. Its only known caller is sub_485B90 (0x00485B90).

Doubly-linked-list append: allocates a 16-byte node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03) with value at +0, next at +4, prev at +8, byte flag at +12; links it after the tail this+0x18E0; on an empty list also sets the head this+0x18DC and a secondary pointer this+0x18E4; updates the tail and increments the node count this+0x18E8. No action is taken when a2 is NULL.

Doubly-linked-list append: allocates a 16-byte node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03), initializes its payload/next/prev/flag fields, links it after the tail this+0x18D0 (or seeds the head this+0x18CC and a secondary pointer this+0x18D4 on an empty list), updates the tail and increments the count this+0x18D8. A null a2 returns immediately without touching the list.

Iterates a singly linked list seeded from the head pointer at this+0x4 into a cursor at this+0xC, accumulating ShortComputation_58d0 (0x004958D0) of each node's first DWORD until the cursor is null or the node value is zero; advances via the node's next pointer at node+4 and returns the accumulated sum.

Reads the float field at byte offset 0xDC (this[55]) and compares it against the zero threshold flt_59E440 (0x0059E440, ~0.0f), returning BOOL true when the field is positive. Called by UILargeRender (0x00496930); the sign of the field likely indicates an active state.
Trivial __thiscall byte getter: returns the byte field at offset 0x25 of this; no side effects, guards, globals or callees. Called by sub_496E90 (0x00496E90).

Trivial __thiscall byte-flag setter: copies the incoming byte parameter a2 into the byte field at offset 0x25 of this and returns the stored value; unconditional write, no guards, globals or callees. Structurally a twin of ByteFieldSetter (00497250), which writes the same offset.

Conditional __thiscall setter: stores the incoming parameter a2 into the dword field at offset 0x30 of this (this[12]) only when a2 is non-zero, and always returns a2 (0 when the write was skipped). No globals or callees. Called by sub_492160 (0x00492160).

Renders a text string through TextRenderToSurface (0x004983B0) and, when the measured width exceeds the caller's limit a2, truncates the string by nulling trailing characters one at a time and re-measuring until the width fits or the string is fully consumed. Returns 0 when the string is NULL, otherwise the last measured result.

If the input string a2 is non-NULL and non-empty, copies it into an internal buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650) and stores the three integer parameters a3, a4, a5 into the adjacent fields at this+0x1560, this+0x1564, this+0x1568, returning a3. If a2 is NULL or empty, the body is skipped and the function returns 0.

Setter on an unknown path-registration object: copies the path string a2 into the internal string buffer at this+0x3C via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650), stores the associated integer a3 at this+0x44, and returns the copy result. Invoked by ProcessingDispatch (0x0046E590).
Getter with no side effects: returns the dword at this+0x44 (this[17]) of the object pointed to by `this`. The caller 0x00495B30 reads this field.

Getter with no side effects: returns the dword at this+0x44 (this[17]) of the object pointed to by `this`. Structurally identical to ShortComputation_8f70 but with no known callers and no ABI lead; equal offset 0x44 on an unrelated this pointer is not proof of shared class.

__thiscall teardown step: writes the vtable pointer off_5ACA30 (0x005ACA30) into this+0x0, then returns the result of the dual list destruction routine on this object. Part of the object teardown sequence initiated by UiDestructorWithConditionalFree (0x00499160).

Iterates a linked list whose head is stored at this+0x44, dispatching a virtual call at vtable offset 0xA4 (attributed by the evidence to the type-info pointer at *(this+0xD0), i.e. slot *(this+0xD0)+0xA4) on each node, then advancing through the node's next pointer at node+0x8C. Terminates on a null node and always returns 0.

Conditional teardown helper: when the byte flag at this+0xC is non-zero, frees the inner heap block stored at this+0x0 via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF); when bit 0 of a2 is set, frees the container object itself; returns the original this pointer unchanged. Called by sub_495300 during object/container teardown.

Trivial single-call wrapper: passes the address of global unk_7CE040 (0x007CE040) as the sole argument to sub_4B3DB0 and returns that callee's result unchanged; no branches, no local computation, no own parameters.

Thin registration wrapper: reads the routine slot NullsubWrapper (global 0x00499680), passes its address cast to an integer to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), and returns its result directly. No callers are recorded.

Trivial single-call wrapper: passes the address of global unk_7CE040 (0x007CE040) as the sole argument to EmptyStub_0170 and returns that callee's result unchanged; no branches, no local computation, no own parameters. This function's own address is the routine slot read by 0x00499670.
Thiscall wrapper that returns the boolean negation of StructEquality(this, a2) (callee 0x00499BB0); a nonzero return indicates the two structures differ.

Struct update plus snapshot: copies six selected DWORD fields from source struct a3 into this (offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0xC, 0x1C, 0x20), then copies the full 52-byte (0x34) content of this into the output buffer a2 via qmemcpy (fields not rewritten by a3 keep their prior this values), and returns the buffer pointer a2.

classes.name: FieldGetter
classes.responsibility: Trivial getters on unknown objects (GUESS merge of six offsets, each a different receiver): returns this+0xE0 zero-check (0x00490190), the positive-float check this+0xDC (0x00496E20), the byte at this+0x25 (0x00497240), the dword at this+0x18 (0x00495970) and the dword at this+0x44 (0x00498F70, 0x0049904C). Merged as one class because all are pure single-field reads with no side effects; the offsets belong to different objects and must not be assumed to share a base type until owners are proven.

classes.name: FieldSetter
classes.responsibility: Trivial setters on unknown objects (GUESS merge of three offsets, each a different receiver): 0x004963C0 writes 1 to this+0x28, 0x004972A6 copies a byte to this+0x25, and 0x004980C0 stores a dword at this+0x30 only when the argument is non-zero. Each returns its stored/argument value.

classes.name: StateDispatchObject
classes.responsibility: State-dependent vtable dispatch family (GUESS grouping): three functions (0x00490330, 0x00490390, 0x004903F0) that compute a state via ShortComputation_6720 (0x00486720), switch on it through their jump tables, dispatch the vtable slot at obj+0x40 with a group-selected argument, then iterate the child dispatch list via VTableDispatchListIteration (0x00490660). They differ in the group arguments (2/5, 4/1, 1/4) and in the unconditional post slot (obj+0x98 for 0x00490330, obj+0x9C for 0x00490390 and 0x004903F0; 0x004903F0 has no post slot). The concrete vtable targets are unknown because every call is indirect.

classes.name: ResourcePoolTeardown
classes.responsibility: Tears down a custom memory-pool/allocator subsystem driven by the globals dword_7CD9D0 (allocator handle) and dword_7CD9CC (pool descriptor). Destroys/frees the handle, then walks and frees the used list (descriptor offset +16) and free list (descriptor start), running per-node conditional cleanup helpers (0x00491E60, 0x00491E80), zeroing each list's head fields, and freeing the descriptor. No this fields are evidenced; descriptor-relative offsets are raw-source descriptions only.

classes.name: RectangleClipper
classes.responsibility: Subtractive rectangle clipping: computes the area of a subject rectangle (this+0 x1, this+2 y1, this+4 / this+6 extents, __int16) outside a boundary rectangle, splits the space into a 3 by 3 grid, allocates a resource-pool node per surviving cell via ResourcePoolNodeAllocDealloc (0x00490940), copies the metadata word from this+8 into node+8, and links the nodes into a singly linked list via the next-pointer at node offset 12. Returns the list head, or 0 when the subject is fully inside the boundary.

classes.name: AxisAlignedBoundingBox
classes.responsibility: Axis-aligned bounding box primitive storing four __int16 values at this+0/0x2/0x4/0x6 (min X, min Y, span X, span Y). 0x004915A0 (AABB containment, owner UNKNOWN in the packet) returns whether the this box lies fully inside a boundary AABB; 0x00491680 (AABB overlap, packet owner DERIVED AxisAlignedBoundingBox) clamps both axes to the shared interval and returns whether both clamped spans are positive. Both sit in broadphase collision culling via callers 0x00490D00 and 0x00491170.

classes.name: DelegateShimObject
classes.responsibility: Single-call delegation shim: reads the object pointer stored at this+0x0, adds 60 bytes to form a _WORD* first argument, and delegates to ShortComputation_16e0 with that pointer plus four __int16 arguments, returning the __int16 result. Identity and layout of the object behind `this` are unknown; the callee is not evidenced in the packet.

classes.name: ConditionalFreeHelper
classes.responsibility: Family of conditional-free teardown helpers (GUESS grouping of three distinct mechanisms, each routing through FreeWrapper_7bcf 0x00587BCF): 0x00491E60 frees its own object when flag bit 0 of a2 is set; 0x00491E80 frees the allocation base (stored pointer minus 4) when this+0x0 is non-null; 0x00499620 frees the inner block at this+0x0 when the byte flag at this+0xC is non-zero and the container itself when bit 0 of a2 is set. Grouped because all are per-node/container cleanup steps used during teardown; each member reads a different subset of fields.

classes.name: CallbackRegistrationShim
classes.responsibility: Registration shims (GUESS grouping): 0x00494620 passes the address of the LinkedListCleanupDestroy routine (global 0x00494630) to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E); 0x00499670 reads the routine slot NullsubWrapper (global 0x00499680) and passes its address cast to int to the same callee. Both return the callee result. Whether 0x00587B3E truly converts bool-to-int or is a callback-registration wrapper is unverified.

classes.name: IdentityPassthrough
classes.responsibility: Identity passthrough returning its first argument a1 unchanged. The frame is flagged unreliable by the decompiler and deterministic facts record a read of global dword_7CDDFC that the rendered source does not show, so the true body is uncertain.

classes.name: GlobalReader
classes.responsibility: Trivial global readers (GUESS merge of two distinct globals): 0x00495110 returns dword_8B8DC8 (consumed by UIScrollViewRender) and 0x00495140 returns dword_7CDE20 (consumed by FileLoadWithRetryLoop). Pure reads with no parameters or side effects; writers are not in this packet.

classes.name: TreeWalker
classes.responsibility: Recursive tree walk (GUESS grouping of two receivers not proven to share a base type): 0x00495920 reads the child pointer at this+0x44 and forwards it into the recursive walk; 0x00495930 walks a linked tree of nodes, invoking a virtual per-node callback at vtable offset +160 (obj+0xA0), recursing into the child subtree at this+0x90 and advancing along the sibling chain, returning 0 after a full traversal (-1 for a NULL root).

classes.name: RenderQueueDrain
classes.responsibility: Drains a list: repeatedly calls sub_495AE0 (0x00495AE0) to process the element at this+0x18 while it is non-null and the guard ShortComputation_8f70 (0x00498F70) returns exactly 1; exits when the guard returns another value or the list empties. The element type and the meaning of the guard value are not evidenced.

classes.name: TextMeasureTruncator
classes.responsibility: Renders a text string through TextRenderToSurface (0x004983B0) and truncates it by nulling trailing characters until the measured width fits the caller's limit a2 or the string is emptied; returns 0 for a NULL string. No owned this fields evidenced; the render object is the receiver.

classes.name: StringFieldSetter
classes.responsibility: Guarded string + three-integer setter: if the input string is non-NULL and non-empty, copies it into an internal buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650) and stores three integer arguments into the adjacent fields at this+0x1560, this+0x1564, this+0x1568, returning the first; otherwise returns 0. The buffer base this+0x1558 is derived from the callee call, not present in the packet field list.

classes.name: PathRegistrationObject
classes.responsibility: Setter on an unknown path-registration object: copies the path string a2 into the internal buffer at this+0x3C via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650), stores the associated integer a3 at this+0x44, and returns the copy result. Invoked by ProcessingDispatch (0x0046E590).

classes.name: VtableResetDtor
classes.responsibility: Teardown step that resets the object's vtable pointer at this+0x0 to off_5ACA30 (0x005ACA30), then returns the result of a dual list destruction routine on this; part of the object teardown sequence initiated by UiDestructorWithConditionalFree (0x00499160). The identity of the dual list destruction routine is not recorded in the packet callee list.

classes.name: LinkedListVirtualDispatch
classes.responsibility: Iterates a linked list whose head is at this+0x44, dispatching a virtual call at vtable offset 0xA4 on each node (the evidence attributes the slot to the type-info pointer at *(this+0xD0)) and advancing via the node's next pointer at node+0x8C; terminates on a null node and returns 0. The relationship between the node's own vtable and the this+0xD0 type-info pointer is unresolved.

classes.name: Global7CE040Wrapper
classes.responsibility: Trivial single-call wrappers (GUESS merge): 0x00499660 calls sub_4B3DB0 and 0x00499680 calls EmptyStub_0170, each passing the address of the global unk_7CE040 (0x007CE040) as the sole argument and returning the callee's result unchanged. The callees are not in the packet callee list, so their signatures are unknown. 0x00499680's own address is the routine slot read by 0x00499670.

classes.name: StructEqualityWrap
classes.responsibility: Thiscall wrapper returning the boolean negation of StructEquality(this, a2) (callee 0x00499BB0). The semantics of StructEquality and the structure layout of this/a2 are outside this packet.

classes.name: StructSnapshotUpdater
classes.responsibility: Struct update plus snapshot: copies six selected DWORD fields from a source struct into this (offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0xC, 0x1C, 0x20), then qmemcpy's the full 52-byte updated this into an output buffer and returns the buffer pointer. Source and destination struct types are unidentified.

classes.name: DoublyLinkedListA
classes.responsibility: Doubly linked list whose embedded header sits at this+0x18CC (head), this+0x18D0 (tail), this+0x18D4 (secondary pointer also set on the empty-list path) and this+0x18D8 (count). Append (0x004967D0) allocates a 16-byte node (payload/next/prev/flag at +0/+4/+8/+12) via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, links it after the tail, seeds the head and secondary pointer on an empty list, and increments the count; a null payload returns immediately. Kept separate from DoublyLinkedListB because the two headers sit at different this offsets and the packet proves no common owner (rule 8).

classes.name: DoublyLinkedListB
classes.responsibility: Doubly linked list whose embedded header sits at this+0x18DC (head), this+0x18E0 (tail), this+0x18E4 (secondary pointer also set on the empty-list path) and this+0x18E8 (count). Append (0x004966E0) allocates a 16-byte node (value/next/prev/flag at +0/+4/+8/+12) via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, links it after the tail, seeds the head and secondary pointer on an empty list, and increments the count; a null payload takes no action. Kept separate from DoublyLinkedListA because the two headers sit at different this offsets and the packet proves no common owner (rule 8).

classes.name: SummationListCursor
classes.responsibility: Iterates a singly linked list seeded from the head pointer at this+0x4 into a cursor at this+0xC, accumulating ShortComputation_58d0 (0x004958D0) of each node's first DWORD until the cursor is null or the node value is zero; advances via the node's next pointer at node+4 and returns the accumulated sum.

state_machines.name: ShortComputation6720StateDispatch
states: group A (state 0-2): vtable slot obj+0x40 dispatched with argument 2 (0x00490330), 4 (0x00490390) or 1 (0x004903F0)
group B (state 3-5): vtable slot obj+0x40 dispatched with argument 5 (0x00490330), 1 (0x00490390) or 4 (0x004903F0)
post-dispatch: unconditional call of vtable slot obj+0x98 (0x00490330) or obj+0x9C (0x00490390 and 0x004903F0); 0x004903F0 has no post slot
child iteration: VTableDispatchListIteration (0x00490660) on every path; all functions return 0
state_machines.transitions: The state is recomputed on every call by ShortComputation_6720 (0x00486720) and switched through the per-function jump tables jpt_49033D (0x00490370), jpt_49039D (0x004903D0) and jpt_4903FD (0x0049042C). The semantics of the state groups (0-2 vs 3-5), of the dispatched arguments, and of the post-dispatch slots are not established by the packet; the mapping is GUESS.

state_machines.name: RenderQueueDrainLoop
states: draining: element at this+0x18 is non-null and the guard ShortComputation_8f70 (0x00498F70) returns 1, so sub_495AE0 (0x00495AE0) processes the current element
guard-fail: ShortComputation_8f70 returns a value other than 1, breaking the loop without processing
list-empty: the element at this+0x18 is null, exiting the loop immediately
state_machines.transitions: The loop condition is re-tested each iteration: the element is popped/processed only when it is non-null and the guard returns exactly 1; either failure exits the drain loop.

interfaces.name: VtableDispatchInterface
interfaces.purpose: Indirect dispatch through object vtables: vtable pointer read at this+0x0 (StateDispatchObject, TreeWalker), command slot at obj+0x40, post-dispatch/refresh slots at obj+0x98 and obj+0x9C, per-node callback at obj+0xA0, and list-node dispatch slot *(this+0xD0)+0xA4. The concrete targets are unknown because every call is indirect through a vtable.

interfaces.name: AllocateFreeService
interfaces.purpose: Shared heap allocation/free wrappers: operator-new with no-throw (0x00587C03) and free (0x00587BCF), consumed by the doubly-linked-list appends (0x004966E0, 0x004967D0) and by the resource-pool teardown and conditional-free helper family (0x00490850, 0x00491E60, 0x00491E80, 0x00499620) as the storage allocation/deallocation boundary.

interfaces.name: StringBufferCopyService
interfaces.purpose: String copy into a growable internal buffer through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650), consumed by the string field setter (0x00498650) and the path registration setter (0x00498D00).

interfaces.name: CallbackRegistrationService
interfaces.purpose: Routine-address registration/conversion through BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E), consumed by the two registration shims (0x00494620 passing LinkedListCleanupDestroy at 0x00494630; 0x00499670 passing NullsubWrapper at 0x00499680). interfaces.name: BroadphaseCullingInterface
